Sterilization Vessel.name: Stainless steel (SS 304/316)
Sterilization Vessel.reasoning: Primary structural material for sterilization vessel due to corrosion resistance and strength, essential for steam pressure containment; industry standard, limited substitutes for steam sterilizer vessels.

Sterilization Vessel.name: Aluminum oxide
Sterilization Vessel.reasoning: Possible coating or surface oxide layer for corrosion resistance; used for durability though alternatives exist.

Sterilization Vessel.name: Glass
Sterilization Vessel.reasoning: Low confidence as viewports or gauges may contain glass, not structural but related to vessel operation.

Boiler Unit.name: Stainless steel (SS 304/316)
Boiler Unit.reasoning: Primary material for boiler tubes and container for corrosion resistance under steam and pressure conditions; widely used with few substitutes.

Boiler Unit.name: Copper
Boiler Unit.reasoning: Commonly used for boiler tubing and heat exchange components because of good thermal conductivity; some designs may use steel alternatives.

Boiler Unit.name: Aluminum oxide
Boiler Unit.reasoning: Used as insulation or protective coating material; moderately confident due to alternatives.

Safety Relief Valve Assembly.name: Stainless steel (SS 316)
Safety Relief Valve Assembly.reasoning: Material used for valve body and critical components due to corrosion resistance and strength; essential for safety valves.

Safety Relief Valve Assembly.name: Copper
Safety Relief Valve Assembly.reasoning: Used for internal components or seals; moderate confidence due to possible alternatives.

Safety Relief Valve Assembly.name: Iron
Safety Relief Valve Assembly.reasoning: May be used in valve springs or mechanical parts but less common than stainless steel; some alternatives exist.

Thermal Regulation/circuit/resistance He.name: Copper
Thermal Regulation/circuit/resistance He.reasoning: Primary electrical conductor for heating elements due to high conductivity and thermal properties; widely used.

Thermal Regulation/circuit/resistance He.name: Nickel
Thermal Regulation/circuit/resistance He.reasoning: Common alloying element or resistance wire material in heaters, provides durability and heat resistance, some substitution possible.

Thermal Regulation/circuit/resistance He.name: Ceramic
Thermal Regulation/circuit/resistance He.reasoning: Used as insulating and heat-resistant housing for heater elements; multiple ceramic types possible.

Pressure And Temperature Sensors.name: Platinum
Pressure And Temperature Sensors.reasoning: Used as sensing resistor material in RTDs (resistance temperature detectors) due to stable resistance properties at temperature; standard in precise temperature sensors.

Pressure And Temperature Sensors.name: Copper
Pressure And Temperature Sensors.reasoning: Used in wiring and sensor components due to conductivity, common choice.

Pressure And Temperature Sensors.name: Stainless steel (SS 304/316)
Pressure And Temperature Sensors.reasoning: Used for sensor housing and protection; common material providing corrosion resistance under steam conditions.

Chassis.name: Steel Ingots
Chassis.reasoning: Base raw material for chassis structural components providing strength and durability; industry standard with limited alternatives.

Chassis.name: Aluminum
Chassis.reasoning: Used in lighter chassis or frame parts for corrosion resistance and weight reduction; some alternatives available.

Vacuum Pump Assembly.name: Stainless steel (SS 316)
Vacuum Pump Assembly.reasoning: Critical structural and moving parts material due to corrosion resistance and strength in vacuum environment.

Vacuum Pump Assembly.name: Copper
Vacuum Pump Assembly.reasoning: Used in motor windings and internal electrical parts; common conductor with alternatives.

Vacuum Pump Assembly.name: Vacuum pump materials
Vacuum Pump Assembly.reasoning: Specialty materials tailored for vacuum pump components including seals and housings, essential for pump function though not detailed here.

Door Assembly With Locking Mechanism.name: Stainless steel (SS 316)
Door Assembly With Locking Mechanism.reasoning: Primary structural material for door and locking components, provides corrosion resistance and strength under pressure.

Door Assembly With Locking Mechanism.name: Glass
Door Assembly With Locking Mechanism.reasoning: Incorporated for observation windows in doors; not structural but critical for monitoring operation.

Door Assembly With Locking Mechanism.name: Aluminum
Door Assembly With Locking Mechanism.reasoning: Used in door frame or locking mechanism parts for weight reduction and corrosion resistance; some alternatives exist.
